blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Abra Lone District Rep. Joseph “JB” Bernos on Thursday urged the government to roll out residential solar installation subsidies modeled on Thailand’s incentive program. He said that financial support for households is essential to boosting the country’s clean energy transition. Subsidizing solar installations will also ease household reliance on the power grid and help families lower their monthly electricity bills, he added in a statement. Thailand is preparing to roll out a nationwide residential rooftop solar panel subsidy of up to ฿50,000, roughly P94,000, to offset installation costs.
